relations.note: Configuring the platform is a separate, deeper skill than using it.

flags: The same word asks for very different things: a sales rep's use of the CRM versus administrator or developer work (Apex, Lightning). Matching should keep these apart.

work_sense: Ability to research users and design how a product works and feels to use, from flows and wireframes to tested prototypes.

definition.text: User experience design is the practice of shaping a product around the people who use it: researching their needs, designing flows, wireframes and prototypes, and testing them. Postings for product and UX designers ask for it, often together with interface design.

variants.condition: it names the design skill rather than the experience itself
it labels a design skill, role or team
names user interface design and user experience design together

relations.note: Visual and interaction design of screens; often joined as UI/UX but not the same.
